title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Integrated Towel Bar Solid Brass | Matte Gray | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a wall mount glass shelf that adds a 16 x 5 inch surface and an integrated towel bar in one streamlined piece in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials.

  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Built-in towel storage: integrated towel bar keeps a hand towel within reach
  • Strong glass: 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with a beveled edge
  • Solid brass hardware: crafted from solid brass materials for durable support
  • Coordinated look: part of the Waverly Place Collection for matching accessories

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
  • Projection: 5 Inches
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Multiple designer finish options available

One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass Waverly Place Collection, this subtle glass shelf is the perfect complement to your bathroom décor.
